  YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Tuesday, November 16, 2021
  6:30 P.M.

  2. To strengthen families; and

minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  November 16, 2021

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Robin Carder at 6:30 p.m.

2. Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Robin Carder, Chair – Council Member
  Rick Crosby, Vice Chair – Council Member
  Greg Palatto - BUSD
  Denise Fisher - Resident

  Don Kendrick, Resident
  Donna Redman, Resident
  Mark Rodgers, BUSD
  Sam Gonzalez, LVPD
  Hollie Savage, LVPD
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne
  Alfie Sanchez, Majestic Cycling/Kiwanis International

3. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the October 26, 2021, meeting were
  approved.

4. School Resource Officer  Lieutenant Sam Gonzalez with the La Verne Police
  Department provided the SRO report noting recent
  activity with vape pens. Lieutenant also shared that
  the department was preparing for the upcoming
  holiday season and other special events.

5. Bike Give Away Event  JR Ranells with the City shared that the giveaway
  event would now be held at the Police Department for
  convenience and practical reasons. The group
  determined that December 15th would be the best
  evening to host the event.

6. Executive Board Vacancies  JR Ranells with the City reported that there had only
  been one application received by the City Clerk to fulfill
  the remaining term on the Executive Board (through
  June 2022). The application was from Don Kendrick.
  The Executive Board unanimously voted to
  recommend to the City Council, Don Kendrick to fulfill
  the vacant term and to reappoint Denise Fisher for a
  new two year term.

10. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for January
  25, 2022.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes November 16, 2021, page 2

11. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:10 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
Assistant to the City Manager
